detaileddescription.para: This method clears the internal data and initialization vectors, and sets the matrix dimensions (rows and columns) to zero. After calling this method, the matrix is considered uninitialized and must be resized or reconstructed before use.

briefdescription.para: Constructs a DenseMatrix from a moved SparseCOOMatrix.

detaileddescription.para: This constructor converts a sparse matrix in Coordinate List (COO) format into a fully populated DenseMatrix. Each non-zero entry in the sparse matrix is inserted into the dense matrix at its corresponding position. All other entries are initialized to zero.
The sparse matrix is passed as an rvalue reference and is cleared after conversion to prevent redundant data retention.

parameterdescription.para: The SparseCOOMatrix to be converted. Must be an rvalue.
if any entry in the sparse matrix is out of bounds.
The numeric type of the matrix, must be float or double.

briefdescription.para: Copy constructor for DenseMatrix.

detaileddescription.para: Creates a deep copy of another DenseMatrix, duplicating its internal data and initialization state. The resulting matrix is independent of the original.

parameterdescription.para: The DenseMatrix instance to copy.

briefdescription.para: Move constructor for DenseMatrix.

detaileddescription.para: Transfers ownership of the internal data from another DenseMatrix. This is a lightweight operation that avoids deep copying, and the original matrix is left in a valid but empty state.

parameterdescription.para: The DenseMatrix to move from. It will be reset to a zero-sized state.

briefdescription.para: Move constructor: Initializes a DenseMatrix from a SparseCSRMatrix.

detaileddescription.para: This constructor moves the contents of a SparseCSRMatrix into a DenseMatrix. The resulting DenseMatrix is a fully initialized matrix with all non-zero elements from the sparse matrix placed at their corresponding row-column indices. Zero-valued or uninitialized entries in the sparse matrix remain unset in the dense representation.

This constructor does not transfer ownership of internal storage from the SparseCSRMatrix but instead copies the sparse contents into a new dense storage layout and marks the original matrix as logically empty by setting its row and column counts to zero.

T
The numerical type of the matrix (must be float or double).
csr
An rvalue reference to a SparseCSRMatrix instance.
std::out_of_range
if indices in the source matrix are invalid.
The source SparseCSRMatrix is marked as logically empty after this operation.
Example: slt::SparseCSRMatrix<float>sparse=...; slt::DenseMatrix<float>dense(std::move(sparse));

briefdescription.para: Constructs a square identity matrix of size n x n.

parameterdescription.para: Size of the identity matrix (rows and columns).
if n is zero.

briefdescription.para: Constructs a DenseMatrix from a SparseCSRMatrix.

detaileddescription.para: Converts a compressed sparse row (CSR) matrix into a dense representation, preserving all explicitly stored non-zero values. Uninitialized entries in the CSR matrix are marked as uninitialized and set to the default value T{}.

csr
The input SparseCSRMatrix<T> to copy from.
std::out_of_range
if CSR matrix has invalid indexing.
std::bad_alloc
if memory allocation fails.
Example: slt::SparseCSRMatrix<float>csr=...; slt::DenseMatrix<float>dense(csr);

briefdescription.para: Access or assign a value at the specified matrix index (r, c).

detaileddescription.para: This non-const overload allows users to assign a value to an element. If the element has not been previously initialized (tracked via the internal init vector), it will be marked as initialized. If already initialized, it acts as a regular update.
Bounds checking is performed; if the index is out of range, std::out_of_range is thrown.

Column index

simplesect.para: Reference to the value at the specified index

Bounds checking is performed; if the index is out of range, std::out_of_range is thrown.

parameterdescription.para: Row index
Column index

briefdescription.para: Move assignment operator from a SparseCOOMatrix.

detaileddescription.para: Converts a sparse matrix in Coordinate List (COO) format into a fully populated DenseMatrix. All non-zero entries in the sparse matrix are transferred to the dense matrix using move semantics. All other elements are initialized to zero.
If the dimensions of the dense matrix differ from the sparse matrix, the internal buffers are resized. If the dimensions match, existing values are cleared and reused.
After the assignment, the sparse matrix is cleared and left in an empty state.

parameterdescription.para: An rvalue reference to the SparseCOOMatrix to be moved from.

simplesect.para: Reference to the current DenseMatrix after assignment.

parameterdescription.para: If any triplet in the sparse matrix refers to an invalid row or column index.
The element type, must be float or double.

briefdescription.para: Assignment operator to populate this DenseMatrix from a SparseCSRMatrix.

detaileddescription.para: Converts a matrix from CSR (Compressed Sparse Row) format into a dense representation. Non-zero entries from the sparse matrix are copied into the corresponding dense slots. All other entries are zero-initialized.

briefdescription.para: Move-assignment: convert and transfer a SparseCSRMatrix into this DenseMatrix.

detaileddescription.para: All initialized values of the rvalue CSR matrix are copied into the dense storage of this matrix; un-initialized positions remain the default value T{}. After the transfer the source CSR matrix is put into a logically empty state (rows_ = cols_ = 0, vectors cleared).

parameterdescription.para: An rvalue reference to the CSR matrix to consume.

simplesect.para: Reference to this DenseMatrix.

parameterdescription.para: If re-allocation of the dense buffers fails.

simplesect.para: The operation is noexcept except for allocation.

briefdescription.para: Move assignment operator for DenseMatrix.

detaileddescription.para: Transfers ownership of the resources from another matrix to this one. After the move, the source matrix is left in a valid but unspecified state (typically zero dimensions and empty internal buffers).
This is useful for efficient reassignment of temporary matrices without deep copying data.

parameterdescription.para: The source matrix to move from (rvalue reference).

simplesect.para: Reference to this matrix after move assignment.

briefdescription.para: Transposes the matrix in-place.

briefdescription.para: Computes and returns the inverse of a square matrix.
